proof: governed engineering memory: propose/query tools, a separate governed promotion command with typed refusals (no raw transcript auto-promotes), scoped and provenance-bound items, inspectable conflict/supersession; memory is its own durable store (V16), not a per-session log projection.

limitations: automatic context-pack injection of curated memory is a follow-up; promotion authority is a session lease; sensitive-scope promotion is conservatively refused pending policy wiring.
